title: External Pull Request Restriction and Issue First Workflow
description: External PRs are automatically closed for security reasons; all contributions must be submitted as detailed issues acting as feature specifications.
acceptance_criteria: External PRs are automatically closed with a request to open an issue
Users submit detailed issue specifications detailing problem, expected behavior, edge cases, and references

title: Public Issue Assignment and Intent Confirmation
description: Contributors must verify an issue has the public label, is unassigned, and comment intention before beginning development.
acceptance_criteria: Issue must have public label assigned
Issue must be unassigned to any user
Contributor must comment intention to work on issue before starting

title: English Language Requirement for Contributions
description: All issues, pull requests, and discussion comments must be written strictly in English.
acceptance_criteria: Issues, pull requests, and comments must be submitted in English

title: Branching Strategy and Feature Naming Convention
description: All pull requests must target the main branch, and feature branches must follow the naming pattern feat/{issue-id}-{readable-name}.
acceptance_criteria: Target branch for pull requests is main
Feature branches use format feat/{issue-id}-{readable-name}

title: Full Production Build Execution
description: The system environment must support full production builds via npm run build prior to pushing code or opening PRs.
acceptance_criteria: Executing npm run build produces a complete production build without errors

title: OpenCode AI Provider and Model Configuration
description: OpenCode integration supports major AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) or Zen optimized coding models configured in settings.
acceptance_criteria: OpenCode supports configuration for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google AI providers
OpenCode supports Zen optimized coding models

title: AI Code Review and Validation Requirement
description: Contributors must thoroughly review and validate all AI-generated code prior to PR submission; unreviewed code submissions result in repository blocking.
acceptance_criteria: All AI-generated code is reviewed and validated by contributor
Contributors submitting unreviewed AI code are blocked from repository

title: OpenCode Autonomous Spec Implementation Command
description: The OpenCode command /implement <spec-path> enables autonomous implementation of feature specifications located in .agents/plans/.
acceptance_criteria: Command /implement <spec-path> parses specification from .agents/plans/
Executes autonomous feature implementation based on specified plan

title: OpenCode Session Continuation Command
description: The OpenCode command /continue <spec-path> resumes specification implementation from a previous development session.
acceptance_criteria: Command /continue <spec-path> resumes implementation from previous session state

title: OpenCode Deep Dive Interview Command
description: The OpenCode command /interview <file-path> initiates an interactive deep-dive Q&A to refine feature specifications or designs.
acceptance_criteria: Command /interview <file-path> initiates interactive Q&A to flesh out requirements and design details

title: OpenCode MDX Documentation Generation Command
description: The OpenCode command /document <module-path> automatically generates MDX documentation for a specified module or feature.
acceptance_criteria: Command /document <module-path> generates structured MDX documentation for target module

title: OpenCode Conventional Commit Command
description: The OpenCode command /commit generates a standardized conventional commit for staged git changes.
acceptance_criteria: Command /commit analyzes staged changes and constructs a conventional commit message

title: OpenCode Plan File Creation Command
description: The OpenCode command /create-plan <slug> creates a new plan specification file in .agents/plans/ using unique ID naming format.
acceptance_criteria: Command /create-plan <slug> generates plan file in .agents/plans/
Filename follows {word}-{word}-{word}-{slug}.md pattern

title: OpenCode Scratch File Creation Command
description: The OpenCode command /create-scratch <slug> creates a temporary scratch file for notes in .agents/scratches/ using unique ID naming format.
acceptance_criteria: Command /create-scratch <slug> creates scratch file in .agents/scratches/
Filename follows {word}-{word}-{word}-{slug}.md pattern

title: OpenCode Justification File Creation Command
description: The OpenCode command /create-justification <slug> creates a technical decision rationale file in .agents/justifications/ using unique ID naming format.
acceptance_criteria: Command /create-justification <slug> creates justification file in .agents/justifications/
Filename follows {word}-{word}-{word}-{slug}.md pattern

title: Agent Artifact Unique ID File Naming
description: All AI agent artifacts generated in .agents/ store files using format {word}-{word}-{word}-{slug}.md to prevent file naming collisions.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact files created in .agents/ directory structure conform to {word}-{word}-{word}-{slug}.md pattern
Prevents merge and file collisions

title: Security Vulnerability Private Reporting
description: Security issues must not be reported via public issue trackers and must follow private security reporting procedures.
acceptance_criteria: Public issue submission for security vulnerabilities is prohibited
Security issues follow private reporting workflow per SECURITY.md

title: Drag and Drop Field Placement
description: Users can select fields from a palette in the document editor sidebar and drag and drop them directly onto any position on the document page.
acceptance_criteria: Field palette displays available field types in the editor sidebar.
User can click and drag a field type from the palette onto the document.
The dropped field is placed at the location on the document where it was dropped.

title: Signature Field Type Support
description: Provides a Signature field type that captures a legally binding signature from the assigned recipient during signing.
acceptance_criteria: Signature field type is available in the palette.
Captures legally binding signature during document signing workflow.

title: Initials Field Type Support
description: Provides an Initials field type to capture recipient abbreviated signatures for acknowledging specific pages or clauses.
acceptance_criteria: Initials field type is available in the palette.
Captures recipient initials for acknowledging pages or terms.

title: Auto-filled Name Field Type
description: Provides a Name field type that automatically populates with the assigned recipient's full name when available.
acceptance_criteria: Name field type is available in the palette.
Auto-fills with recipient's full name during signing.

title: Auto-filled Email Field Type
description: Provides an Email field type that automatically populates with the assigned recipient's email address.
acceptance_criteria: Email field type is available in the palette.
Auto-fills with recipient's email address during signing.

title: Auto-filled Completion Date Field
description: Provides a Date field type that automatically populates with the date when the field/document was completed.
acceptance_criteria: Date field type is available in the palette.
Auto-fills with the date the field was completed by the signer.

title: Free-form Text Field Type
description: Provides a Text field type allowing recipients to enter free-form string data.
acceptance_criteria: Text field type is available in the palette.
Allows free-form text input during document execution.

title: Numeric Input Field Type
description: Provides a Number field type that accepts numeric inputs with optional min/max validation and formatting.
acceptance_criteria: Number field type is available in the palette.
Restricts input to numbers.
Supports min value, max value, and number format validation.

title: Checkbox Selection Field Type
description: Provides a Checkbox field type enabling multiple options selection.
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox field type is available in the palette.
Allows recipients to select multiple options.

title: Radio Selection Field Type
description: Provides a Radio button field type enabling single option selection from a defined group.
acceptance_criteria: Radio field type is available in the palette.
Allows recipients to select exactly one option from a set.

title: Dropdown Menu Field Type
description: Provides a Dropdown menu field type allowing single option selection from a dropdown list.
acceptance_criteria: Dropdown field type is available in the palette.
Displays a menu of defined options for single selection.

title: Mandatory Signer Signature Constraint
description: Enforces a system rule that every recipient designated as a Signer must have at least one Signature field assigned prior to sending the document.
acceptance_criteria: System prevents sending a document if any Signer recipient lacks a Signature field.
Displays error/validation warning when trying to send without required signature fields.

title: Recipient Color Coding for Fields
description: Color-codes fields on the document to visually match the color assigned to the corresponding recipient in the sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Each recipient in the recipient list is assigned a distinct color indicator.
Fields placed on the document inherit the color of their assigned recipient.
Selecting a recipient in the sidebar highlights their assigned fields.

title: Reassign Field Recipient Ownership
description: Allows changing the assigned recipient of an existing field via the field properties panel.
acceptance_criteria: User can click a field to open properties panel.
User can change assigned recipient from the Recipient dropdown.
Field visual color updates dynamically to reflect new recipient.

title: Recipient Role Rules for Field Assignment
description: Enforces recipient role permissions regarding field assignments: Signers require at least one signature, Approvers can have fields optional, Viewers cannot have fields assigned, and Assistants can pre-fill fields.
acceptance_criteria: Signers require at least 1 Signature field.
Approvers can be assigned optional fields.
Viewers cannot be assigned any fields.
Assistants can pre-fill fields on behalf of other recipients.

title: Field Repositioning and Alignment Snapping
description: Allows clicking and dragging any field to reposition it on the document with visual alignment snapping guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: User can drag placed fields across the document.
Fields snap automatically to align with document margins and other adjacent fields.

title: Field Resizing via Corner Handles
description: Allows users to resize placed fields by selecting the field and dragging corner handles.
acceptance_criteria: Corner handles appear when selecting a field.
Dragging corner handles adjusts field width and height.
Resizing applies to signature, text, and other configurable fields.

title: Multi-Page Field Placement Navigation
description: Provides page navigation controls allowing fields to be placed on any page of a multi-page PDF document.
acceptance_criteria: User can navigate between pages using page controls.
Fields remain bound to the specific page on which they were dropped.

title: Common Field Properties Configuration
description: Supports standard field properties configurable across fields: Required toggle, Read-only toggle, Label, and Font size (8-96px).
acceptance_criteria: User can toggle 'Required' status for a field.
User can toggle 'Read-only' with pre-filled locked values.
User can enter custom 'Label' text displayed above field.
User can set 'Font size' within range 8px to 96px.

title: Text Field Property Configuration
description: Provides specialized configuration properties for Text fields including Placeholder, Default value, Character limit, and Text alignment.
acceptance_criteria: User can specify Placeholder hint text.
User can set pre-filled Default value.
User can set maximum Character limit.
User can select Text alignment (Left, Center, Right).

title: Number Field Property Configuration
description: Provides specialized configuration properties for Number fields including Minimum value, Maximum value, and Number format.
acceptance_criteria: User can configure Minimum allowed numeric value.
User can configure Maximum allowed numeric value.
User can set display Number format.

title: Selection Field Property Configuration
description: Provides configuration for Checkbox, Radio, and Dropdown fields including options list, default selections, and vertical/horizontal layout direction.
acceptance_criteria: User can manage list of selectable Options.
User can set pre-selected Default selection(s).
User can choose layout Direction (Vertical or Horizontal) for Checkbox and Radio fields.

title: Field Deletion Action
description: Allows users to delete fields from a document using keyboard shortcuts or UI action button.
acceptance_criteria: Selected field is deleted when pressing Delete or Backspace key.
Selected field is deleted when clicking delete icon in properties panel.

title: Field Duplication Action
description: Allows duplicating existing fields using standard copy and paste keyboard shortcuts.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a field and pressing Ctrl+C / Cmd+C copies field configuration.
Pressing Ctrl+V / Cmd+V creates duplicate field on the document.

title: Sequential Signing Order Enablement
description: Provides option to enable sequential signing order when preparing documents with multiple recipients.
acceptance_criteria: User can toggle signing order setting.
When enabled, recipients receive document signing invitations in strict sequential order.

title: Pre-Send Document Validation Rules
description: Before a document can be sent, the platform must validate that at least one recipient is added, signature fields are assigned to each signer, and required email addresses are present for recipients with authentication enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Prevent document sending if zero recipients are defined.
Prevent sending if a signer role recipient lacks an assigned signature field.
Require recipient email addresses if recipient authentication is enabled.

title: Send Document via Email Distribution
description: Send document signing requests via email to recipients with customizable subject, message, and reply-to parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Allow user to select 'Email' as distribution method.
Send individual emails with unique signing links to each recipient.
Change document status from Draft to Pending upon sending.

title: Generate Signing Links without Email Distribution
description: Allow sending documents with distribution method set to 'None' to generate manual signing links without sending email notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Allow user to select 'None' as distribution method.
Redirect user to document page displaying generated signing links upon clicking 'Generate Links'.
Allow copying of individual signing links for manual sharing via external channels.

title: Configure Custom Reply-To Email Address
description: Allow document senders to set a custom reply-to email address so recipient replies do not go to the default system sender.
acceptance_criteria: Provide an optional Reply-To input field in send modal and document settings.
Route recipient email replies to the specified reply-to address.

title: Customize Email Subject Line by Role
description: Allow custom email subjects while defaulting to role-specific subjects for Signers, Approvers, and Viewers if left blank.
acceptance_criteria: Allow custom text input for email subject.
Default to 'Please sign this document' for Signers if blank.
Default to 'Please approve this document' for Approvers if blank.
Default to 'Please view this document' for Viewers if blank.
Include team name in default subject if document belongs to a team.

title: Customize Email Body Message with Template Variables
description: Support custom body messages in email notifications with support for variables like recipient name, email, and document name.
acceptance_criteria: Allow user to enter custom email body message.
Replace `{signer.name}` variable with recipient's actual name.
Replace `{signer.email}` variable with recipient's actual email.
Replace `{document.name}` variable with the document title.
Generate default fallback body message if left blank based on role and organization context.

title: Enterprise Custom Sender Email Configuration
description: Allow enterprise organization accounts to configure custom sender email addresses for all outgoing document notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Enable custom sender email configuration in enterprise organization settings.
Use configured custom email address as the 'From' address for outbound signing emails.

title: Recipient Signing Link Expiration Control
description: Provide unique signing links per recipient that automatically expire when the document is completed or deleted.
acceptance_criteria: Ensure each recipient receives a distinct signing link.
Invalidate signing links immediately when document reaches Completed status.
Invalidate signing links immediately when document is deleted.

title: Document Status Tracking
description: Senders can view progress on the Documents dashboard by inspecting individual documents to check which recipients have signed and which actions remain pending.
acceptance_criteria: Display current status on document details page (Pending, Completed, Rejected).
Show signing status per recipient on the document detail page.
Documents dashboard displays status indicators for each recipient (signed vs pending).
Selecting a document shows granular recipient status breakdown.

title: Resend Document Reminders to Pending Recipients
description: Allow senders to resend email reminders to selected recipients who have not yet signed a pending document.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 'Resend' option in actions menu (three dots) for documents in 'Pending' status.
Allow selecting specific unsigned recipients to send reminders to.
Prefix email subject with 'Reminder:' when sending reminder emails.
Reuse original message context in reminder emails.

title: Delete Pending Document with Typed Confirmation
description: Allow user to permanently delete pending documents requiring manual confirmation input of the word 'delete'.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 'Delete' option in action menu for pending documents.
Require user to type 'delete' in confirmation prompt before enabling deletion action.
Void all existing signatures on deletion.
Send cancellation emails to recipients upon deleting pending document.

title: Status-Based Document Deletion Logic
description: Enforce specific document deletion behaviors based on current document status (Draft, Pending, Completed).
acceptance_criteria: Draft status deletion: Permanently delete document without sending notifications.
Pending status deletion: Permanently delete document, void signatures, send cancellation emails.
Completed status deletion: Hide document from account while allowing recipients to retain signed copies.

title: Configure Document Notification Language
description: Allow user to select the preferred language for recipient notification emails in document settings.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 'Language' dropdown setting in Document Settings.
Send recipient email notifications in the selected language.

title: Configure Allowed Signature Types
description: Allow senders to restrict signature input methods available to signers (draw, type, upload).
acceptance_criteria: Provide selection options for 'Allowed Signature Types' in Document Settings.
Support configuration for 'draw', 'type', and 'upload' signature methods.
Restrict signers to only configured signature types during signing.

title: Configure Document Date Format and Time Zone
description: Allow senders to set specific date formats and time zones for date fields inserted into the document.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 'Date Format' configuration option in Document Settings.
Provide 'Time Zone' configuration option in Document Settings.
Format filled date fields according to defined document date format and timezone.

title: Configure Document External ID for Integrations
description: Allow users to attach a custom external identifier to a document for tracking in external systems.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 'External ID' text field in Document Settings.
Store and expose external ID via API responses and webhooks.

title: Configure Template Post-Signing Redirect URL
description: Specify a post-signing Redirect URL on a template to automatically send recipients to a designated web page upon completing document signature.
acceptance_criteria: Provide 'Redirect URL' setting field in Document Settings.
Redirect signer to configured URL upon successful completion of document actions.
User can enter a Redirect URL in template settings.
Recipients are redirected to the URL after completing document signing.

title: Document-Level Access Control Security Settings
description: Configure document-level access authentication requirements for viewing and accessing signing links.
acceptance_criteria: Provide document access control options: 'Require account', 'Require 2FA', and 'None'.
Enforce signed-in account requirement if 'Require account' is selected.
Enforce two-factor authentication if 'Require 2FA' is selected.
Allow direct link access without login if 'None' is selected.

title: Enterprise Recipient Authentication on Signing
description: Require additional verification (passkey or 2FA) when a recipient signs a signature field, with per-recipient override capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Provide Recipient Authentication options: 'Require passkey', 'Require 2FA', and 'None'.
Allow global setting at document level and override per individual recipient.
Enforce passkey or 2FA check when recipient submits signature field.

title: Attach Auxiliary Files to Document
description: Allow users to attach supplementary files to a document from the editor header, which will be included with the completed signed document.
acceptance_criteria: Provide file attachment upload action in right-hand side of editor header.
Bundle attached files with the final completed document download/package.

title: PDF File Format Support
description: The platform must support uploading PDF (.pdf) files directly without requiring document conversion.
acceptance_criteria: User can upload .pdf files
System uses PDF files as-is without quality loss or layout conversion

title: DOCX File Upload and Conversion
description: The system must accept Word (.docx) files and convert them to PDF on the server side during upload before adding them to an envelope.
acceptance_criteria: User can upload .docx files
System automatically converts .docx files to PDF using LibreOffice
The original .docx file is discarded after conversion, storing only the converted PDF

title: Unsupported File Format Validation
description: The system must reject unsupported file formats (such as .doc, .odt, .rtf, and image formats) and prompt the user to upload PDF or DOCX files.
acceptance_criteria: System rejects legacy .doc, .odt, .rtf, and image file extensions
Display clear error message stating 'Only PDF and DOCX files are allowed'

title: Encrypted PDF Rejection
description: The platform must reject encrypted or password-protected PDF files during upload.
acceptance_criteria: System detects password protection or encryption on PDF files
Upload is blocked and warning message is displayed instructing user to remove encryption

title: Maximum File Size Enforcement
description: The system must enforce a 50MB file size limit for uploads, configurable for self-hosted instances.
acceptance_criteria: Files exceeding 50MB (or self-hosted configured limit) are rejected
Display error message instructing user to reduce file size

title: Drag and Drop Upload
description: As a user, I want to drag and drop files anywhere on the Documents dashboard to quickly upload them.
acceptance_criteria: User can drop PDF or DOCX files anywhere on the Documents dashboard
Upload starts automatically and redirects to document editor upon completion

title: Upload Document Button
description: As a user, I want to click an 'Upload Document' button to open the system file picker and select files for upload.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Upload Document' button opens system file picker
User can choose PDF or DOCX files to initiate upload

title: Multi-Document Envelope Upload
description: Users can select or drag multiple PDF and DOCX files at once to create a single envelope containing multiple documents, bounded by plan limits.
acceptance_criteria: User can select multiple files simultaneously via drag-and-drop or file picker
PDF and DOCX files can be combined in the same envelope upload
All uploaded files share the same envelope recipients and signing workflow
Enforce maximum allowed files per envelope based on user subscription plan

title: Automatic Draft Creation on Upload
description: When a document upload completes, the system validates the PDF, extracts page data, creates a document in Draft status, and opens the editor.
acceptance_criteria: Document status is set to Draft upon successful upload and processing
Page metadata is extracted and available in the editor
User is automatically redirected to the document editor

title: Automatic Saving of Draft Documents
description: Draft documents must automatically persist changes so users can close the editor and resume editing later without losing progress.
acceptance_criteria: Draft documents retain state automatically
Users can close and reopen draft documents from the dashboard

title: DOCX Form Control Flattening
description: Word content controls (drop-downs, date pickers, checkboxes) in DOCX files must be flattened into static elements during PDF conversion.
acceptance_criteria: Content controls in DOCX are rendered as static text or graphics in the converted PDF
Interactive field placement requires Documenso field controls

title: Configurable Document Conversion Service
description: Self-hosted instances must support enabling and configuring a document conversion service to process DOCX uploads.
acceptance_criteria: Self-hosted admins can configure document conversion service endpoints
If unconfigured, DOCX uploads are gracefully rejected with a helpful message

title: Monthly Document Limit Enforcement
description: The platform must track monthly document upload usage and prevent uploads when the plan quota limit is exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: Block upload if monthly document quota is reached
Display error message detailing options: wait for reset, upgrade plan, or delete unused draft documents

title: Delete Draft Document
description: Users can delete unused draft documents from their dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: User can delete a draft document
Deleting a draft document removes it permanently
Deleting a draft does not restore consumed monthly quota

title: Conversion Error Handling and Messaging
description: System must display appropriate troubleshooting guidance for conversion failures, such as file corruption, unavailable conversion service, or timeout.
acceptance_criteria: Display specific error messages when conversion service is unreachable or times out
Provide actionable advice to export as PDF directly when rendering or conversion errors occur

title: Access Document Editor from Dashboard
description: Allow users to open the document editor by selecting any existing document from the Documents dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: User can click on a document row in the Documents dashboard
User is redirected to the document editor interface for that document

title: Automatic Redirect to Editor After Upload
description: Automatically transition the user to the document editor immediately upon completing a document file upload.
acceptance_criteria: Document file upload process finishes successfully
System automatically redirects user to the document editor view

title: Add Recipient Row
description: Provide a control to add a new recipient row within the document editor's Recipients panel.
acceptance_criteria: User clicks '+ Add Signer'
A new recipient input row appears in the Recipients section
Multiple recipients can be added sequentially by repeating the action

title: Require Recipient Email Address
description: Require a valid email address for every added recipient to receive document signing invitations.
acceptance_criteria: Email input field is mandatory for each recipient
Signing invitation is dispatched to the configured recipient email address upon sending

title: Optional Recipient Display Name
description: Allow entry of an optional recipient name to identify signers in notifications, logs, and completion certificates.
acceptance_criteria: User can enter an optional recipient name
Provided name displays in the invitation email, activity log, and signature certificate
If name is omitted, recipient's email address is displayed in place of the name

title: Assign Signer Role
description: Allow assigning the Signer role to a recipient, requiring them to execute signature fields on the document.
acceptance_criteria: User selects 'Signer' role for a recipient
Recipient is required to fill placed fields/sign the document

title: Assign Approver Role
description: Allow assigning the Approver role to a recipient, requiring them to approve the document.
acceptance_criteria: User selects 'Approver' role for a recipient
Approver must approve document for completion; signing fields are optional

title: Assign Viewer Role
description: Allow assigning the Viewer role to a recipient, requiring confirmation that they viewed the document.
acceptance_criteria: User selects 'Viewer' role for a recipient
Viewer is prompted to confirm document viewing without signing requirements

title: Assign Assistant Role
description: Allow assigning the Assistant role to pre-fill fields for other recipients prior to signer interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Assistant role is selectable only when sequential signing order is enabled
Assistant acts before signers whose fields they pre-fill

title: Assign CC Role
description: Allow assigning the CC role so recipients receive a copy of the finalized document after completion.
acceptance_criteria: User selects 'CC' role for a recipient
CC recipient receives a copy of the signed document automatically after completion

title: Default Parallel Signing Workflow
description: Process recipient invitations concurrently by default when document signing order is not explicitly enabled.
acceptance_criteria: New documents default to parallel signing mode
All recipients receive signing invitation emails simultaneously

title: Enable Sequential Signing Order Toggle
description: Provide a toggle switch to enable sequential signing workflow for document recipients.
acceptance_criteria: User toggles 'Enable signing order' switch
Order input fields become visible/editable per recipient
Enables selection of the Assistant role

title: Configure Recipient Signing Sequence Step Number
description: Allow specifying numeric step values to define the sequence in which recipients receive and act on the document.
acceptance_criteria: User can assign step numbers (1, 2, 3, etc.) to recipients
Each recipient is notified only after all preceding step actions are completed

title: Group Recipients for Parallel Steps in Sequential Order
description: Allow multiple recipients to share the same sequence order number to act simultaneously at that step.
acceptance_criteria: Assigning identical step numbers to multiple recipients notifies them concurrently at that step
Workflow advances to the next step number only after all recipients at current step complete required actions

title: Modify Recipient Details Before Sending
description: Allow updating recipient email, name, role, and signing order on unsent documents.
acceptance_criteria: User can modify email, name, role, or step order fields prior to sending
Changes update successfully in the document state

title: Remove Recipient from Document
description: Allow removing a recipient row from an unsent document using a trash delete action.
acceptance_criteria: User clicks delete icon (trash) next to a recipient row
Selected recipient row is removed from the document

title: Cascade Delete Assigned Fields on Recipient Removal
description: Automatically purge all document fields assigned to a recipient when that recipient is removed.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient is deleted from document editor
All signature and input fields linked to the deleted recipient are removed automatically from document pages

title: Prevent Modifying Recipients After Sending
description: Lock document recipient lists against edits, additions, or deletions after document dispatch.
acceptance_criteria: Document status transitions to sent
Recipient fields and controls become disabled/read-only
Recipient modification attempts via API or UI after sending are rejected

title: Enable Direct Link on Template
description: Allow template owners to enable direct link sharing on templates to collect signatures without knowing recipient email addresses in advance.
acceptance_criteria: User can open the Direct Link modal from the template context menu
User can click 'Enable direct link' to activate direct link sharing
A unique direct link URL in format https://app.documenso.com/d/<unique-token> is generated

title: Select or Create Direct Link Recipient Role
description: Allow template owners to bind a direct link to an existing recipient role or automatically generate a dedicated 'Direct Link Recipient' role.
acceptance_criteria: User can choose an existing recipient defined in the template
User can select 'Create one automatically' to create a Direct Link Recipient role
Direct link field assignments are mapped to the selected recipient role

title: Copy Generated Direct Link URL
description: Provide a quick action to copy the generated direct link URL for sharing via email, social media, QR codes, or web embeds.
acceptance_criteria: Generated direct link URL is displayed to the user
User can copy URL to clipboard with one click

title: Lock Direct Link Recipient Modifications While Active
description: Prevent users from editing or deleting a direct link recipient role while the direct link remains active.
acceptance_criteria: Direct link recipient role cannot be edited or deleted while direct link is active
System displays warning message instructing user to disable direct link before modifying recipient

title: Access Direct Link Signing Page
description: Allow anonymous recipients to access the signing interface via direct link URL without prior email invitation.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient opening direct link URL sees the document with fields assigned to direct link recipient role
No login or upfront email invitation is required to access signing view

title: Recipient Self-Identification on Direct Link
description: Require recipients accessing documents via direct link to enter their own name and email address before completing document fields.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient is prompted for Full Name and Email Address
System validates email address format prior to submission
Submitted identity is associated with signature audit trail

title: Deliver Signed Copy to Direct Link Recipient
description: Automatically send an email containing a copy of the completed document to the recipient upon signing via direct link.
acceptance_criteria: Email sent to recipient's entered email address immediately upon completion
Email contains attachment or secure link to completed PDF

title: Notify Template Owner on Direct Link Completion
description: Send notification to the template owner every time a recipient signs and completes a document via direct link.
acceptance_criteria: Template owner receives notification upon each completed direct link signature
Completed document appears in template owner's dashboard

title: Link Signed Document to Registered User Account
description: Automatically add completed direct link documents to a recipient's dashboard if they hold an account matching entered email.
acceptance_criteria: System checks if entered email belongs to registered user
Completed document automatically populates in recipient's Documents dashboard

title: Disable Direct Link Temporarily
description: Allow template owners to temporarily disable direct links to stop accepting signatures while preserving the direct link URL.
acceptance_criteria: User can toggle direct link switch to off in template settings
Direct link URL stops accepting signatures while disabled
Re-enabling direct link retains original URL token

title: Delete Direct Link and Regenerate Token
description: Allow users to remove direct links and generate a new URL token upon re-enablement.
acceptance_criteria: After disabling direct link, user can delete direct link recipient
Enabling direct link subsequently generates a new unique direct link token

title: Configure Public Profile Display Settings
description: Allow users to enable and configure their public profile settings to showcase direct link templates.
acceptance_criteria: User can navigate to Settings > Public Profile
User can toggle Public Profile activation status

title: Publish Direct Link Templates on Profile Page
description: Allow users to add active direct link templates to their public profile so visitors can sign agreements directly.
