title: Document Upload via Dashboard
description: Users can upload PDF documents from the Documents dashboard using an explicit 'Upload Document' button or via drag-and-drop, after which they are redirected to the document editor.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Upload Document' opens a file picker or accepts drag-and-dropped files.
Successfully uploaded files automatically transition the user to the document editor.

title: Add Document Recipients
description: Senders can add multiple recipients to a document by clicking '+ Add Signer' and specifying their name and email address.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking '+ Add Signer' opens fields for recipient email address and name.
Multiple recipients can be added to a single document.

title: Recipient Role Selection
description: Senders can assign one of four roles to each recipient: Signer (must sign), Approver (must approve, signature optional), Viewer (must confirm viewing), or CC (receives a copy post-completion without taking action).
acceptance_criteria: Users can select between Signer, Approver, Viewer, and CC roles for each recipient.
Signer role requires document signing.
Approver role requires approval action.
Viewer role requires view confirmation.
CC recipients receive completed document copy with no required action.

title: Enforce Sequential Signing Order
description: Senders can enable 'Signing Order' to ensure document recipients receive and sign the document in a specific configured sequence.
acceptance_criteria: Senders can enable a 'Signing Order' toggle/setting.
When enabled, recipients receive signing requests sequentially based on designated order.

title: Place Fields on Document
description: Senders can select a recipient from the sidebar and drag field types (Signature, Name, Date, Initials) onto specific locations on the PDF document.
acceptance_criteria: Supported field types include Signature, Name, Date, and Initials.
Fields can be dragged and dropped onto specific coordinates on document pages.
Each field is explicitly assigned to a chosen recipient.

title: Field Color-Coding and Resizing
description: Document fields are color-coded according to recipient assignment and can be visually resized by dragging corner handles in the editor.
acceptance_criteria: Fields belonging to different recipients display distinct visual color coding.
Users can resize field dimensions visually by dragging corner handles.

title: Mandatory Signature Field Requirement
description: The system mandates that every recipient designated with the 'Signer' role must have at least one Signature field placed on the document before sending.
acceptance_criteria: Validation prevents sending if any Signer lacks a assigned Signature field.

title: Preview and Send Document
description: Senders can navigate to a Preview section to review document and field configurations, then execute sending via the 'Send Document' or 'Send' button.
acceptance_criteria: A preview section allows review of all document fields, recipients, and settings.
Clicking 'Send' initiates document dispatch to recipients.

title: Email Invitation to Recipients
description: When a document is sent, assigned recipients automatically receive an email notification containing a link to access and complete their assigned fields.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients automatically receive an email invitation upon document dispatch.
The email contains a functional link directing the recipient to their signing view.

title: Sender Progress Notifications
description: The sender receives automatic notifications whenever an individual recipient completes their required action on a document.
acceptance_criteria: Sender is notified when a recipient signs, approves, or views the document.

title: Final Document Distribution
description: Once all required actions are completed by all recipients, all participants (including CC'd recipients) receive an email with a copy of the fully executed document.
acceptance_criteria: All signers, approvers, viewers, and CC recipients receive a final copy of the signed PDF upon document completion.

title: Standardized Webhook Event Envelope Structure
description: The platform must send webhook notifications using a standardized payload structure containing event type identifier, event payload, creation timestamp, and target endpoint URL.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level payload includes 'event' string identifier
Top-level payload includes 'payload' object with document/template details
Top-level payload includes ISO datetime string 'createdAt'
Top-level payload includes 'webhookEndpoint' string URL

title: Document Created Webhook Notification
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_CREATED webhook event whenever a new document draft is created.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_CREATED upon document initialization
Payload contains initial document status DRAFT
Payload includes full recipient list and document metadata

title: Document Sent Webhook Notification
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_SENT webhook event when a document is dispatched to recipients for signature.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_SENT when document is sent
Updates document status to PENDING
Sets recipient sendStatus to SENT

title: Document First Opened Webhook Notification
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_OPENED webhook event when a recipient opens the document link for the first time.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_OPENED on first document view by recipient
Updates recipient readStatus from NOT_OPENED to OPENED

title: Individual Signature Webhook Event Notification
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_SIGNED webhook event each time an individual recipient completes signing a document.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_SIGNED immediately when a signer signs
Updates recipient signingStatus to SIGNED
Populates signedAt timestamp for the recipient

title: Recipient Action Completed Webhook Event
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_RECIPIENT_COMPLETED webhook event when an individual recipient finishes their designated role action (signing, approving, or viewing).
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_RECIPIENT_COMPLETED per recipient action completion
Supports SIGNER, APPROVER, and VIEWER recipient actions

title: All Recipients Document Completion Webhook Event
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_COMPLETED webhook event when all assigned recipients have fulfilled their required actions.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_COMPLETED once all recipients complete required actions
Updates document status to COMPLETED
Populates document completedAt timestamp

title: Document Rejection Webhook Notification Event
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_REJECTED webhook event if a recipient declines/rejects to sign the document.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_REJECTED upon recipient rejection
Sets recipient signingStatus to REJECTED
Captures and includes recipient rejectionReason text string

title: Document Cancelled Webhook Notification Event
description: The platform must emit a DOCUMENT_CANCELLED webhook event when a document is deleted/cancelled by the document owner or team member.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers event DOCUMENT_CANCELLED when owner or team member deletes document
Distinguishes hard deletion of draft/pending documents vs soft deletion of completed documents
Does not fire when recipient merely hides document from their view

title: Multiple Recipient Role Support Configuration
description: The platform must support defining recipient roles including Signer, Viewer, Approver, Assistant, and CC.
acceptance_criteria: Allowed recipient roles: SIGNER, VIEWER, APPROVER, ASSISTANT, CC
Include recipient role in document payload objects

title: Customizable Signature Types Field Settings
description: The platform must allow document creators to enable or disable specific signature input types (typed, drawn, uploaded signature) per document.
acceptance_criteria: Support typedSignatureEnabled boolean flag
Support uploadSignatureEnabled boolean flag
Support drawSignatureEnabled boolean flag

title: Parallel and Sequential Signing Sequence Settings
description: The platform must support both parallel and sequential signing orders, including optional capability for signers to dictate the next signer.
acceptance_criteria: Support signingOrder mode PARALLEL or SEQUENTIAL
Support allowDictateNextSigner boolean configuration option
Track numerical signingOrder per recipient

title: Capture Recipient Document Rejection Reason
description: As a recipient, I want to provide a reason when rejecting a document so the sender understands why I refused to sign.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient can reject document and input rejection text
Rejection reason string is saved in recipient object as rejectionReason

title: Recipient Link Expiration and Expiration Reminders
description: The platform must track signing link expiration times and recorded expiration notification timestamps per recipient.
acceptance_criteria: Support expiresAt datetime field on recipient object
Support expirationNotifiedAt datetime field on recipient object

title: Recipient Access and Action Authentication Options
description: The platform must support configuring access and action authentication requirements both globally at the document level and individually per recipient.
acceptance_criteria: Support document-level authOptions
Support per-recipient authOptions containing accessAuth and actionAuth settings
Support optional document access password in metadata

title: Team Account Webhook Access Constraint
description: Webhook configuration functionality must be restricted exclusively to team accounts; personal accounts cannot create or manage webhooks.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook management UI is accessible under Team Settings for team accounts
Personal accounts are blocked from accessing webhook settings

title: Create Webhook Subscription
description: Allow team administrators to create and save a new webhook endpoint by entering a URL, selecting event triggers, and optionally specifying a secret.
acceptance_criteria: User can open the webhook configuration dialog via 'Create Webhook' button
User must input a valid HTTPS Webhook URL
User can select one or more specific event triggers
User can optionally provide a secret key for signature verification
Saving activates the webhook subscription immediately

title: Webhook Endpoint HTTPS Protocol Constraint
description: Webhook endpoints must enforce HTTPS protocol in production, accept HTTP POST requests with application/json payloads, and respond within 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook endpoints reject non-HTTPS URLs in production
Documenso sends events via HTTP POST with Content-Type application/json
Endpoint must return 2xx status code within 30 seconds

title: Webhook Delivery Automatic Retry Policy
description: Automatically retry failed webhook deliveries using exponential backoff up to 5 attempts when a non-2xx response or timeout occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Attempt 1 triggers immediately upon event
Attempt 2 triggers after 1 minute delay
Attempt 3 triggers after 5 minutes delay
Attempt 4 triggers after 30 minutes delay
Attempt 5 triggers after 2 hours delay
Webhook call is marked as permanently failed after 5 failed attempts

title: Webhook Event - Document Created
description: Trigger a DOCUMENT_CREATED webhook event notification whenever a new document is created.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_CREATED upon document creation
Documenso dispatches a webhook notification with event type DOCUMENT_CREATED upon document creation.
Payload includes event metadata and document details.

title: Webhook Event - Document Reminder Sent
description: Support trigger and payload delivery for the DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT webhook event when a reminder email is dispatched to a recipient.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_SENT when a document is dispatched
Documenso dispatches a webhook notification with event type DOCUMENT_SENT when a document is sent.
Payload includes event details and associated document payload.
Documenso dispatches DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT event whenever a reminder is sent to signers.
Payload includes recipient and reminder metadata.

title: Webhook Event - Document Opened
description: Trigger a DOCUMENT_OPENED webhook event notification when a recipient opens a document for the first time.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_OPENED when a recipient initially accesses the document link
Documenso dispatches a webhook notification with event type DOCUMENT_OPENED when a recipient views the document.
Payload contains recipient and document event details.

title: Webhook Event - Document Signed
description: Trigger a DOCUMENT_SIGNED webhook event notification whenever any recipient signs a document.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_SIGNED upon recipient signature submission
Documenso dispatches a webhook notification with event type DOCUMENT_SIGNED when a recipient completes signing fields.
Payload contains document and signing metadata.

title: Webhook Event - Document Recipient Completed
description: Support trigger and payload delivery for the DOCUMENT_RECIPIENT_COMPLETED webhook event when an individual recipient finishes all required actions.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_COMPLETED after final recipient signs or completes actions
Documenso dispatches DOCUMENT_RECIPIENT_COMPLETED event when a single recipient completes all assigned fields/actions.
Payload identifies the completed recipient and document status.

title: Webhook Event - Document Rejected
description: Trigger a DOCUMENT_REJECTED webhook event notification when a recipient rejects a document.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_REJECTED when a recipient explicit rejects the document
Documenso dispatches DOCUMENT_REJECTED event when a recipient rejects or declines the document.
Payload includes rejection details and recipient information.

title: Webhook Event - Reminder Sent
description: Trigger a DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT webhook event notification when a reminder email is issued to a recipient.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT upon sending a recipient reminder

title: Webhook Event - Template Created
description: Trigger a TEMPLATE_CREATED webhook event notification when a new document template is created.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type TEMPLATE_CREATED upon template creation
Documenso dispatches TEMPLATE_CREATED event when a template is added.
Payload contains template metadata and creator information.

title: Webhook Event - Template Updated
description: Trigger a TEMPLATE_UPDATED webhook event notification when an existing document template is modified.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type TEMPLATE_UPDATED upon updating template details or fields
Documenso dispatches TEMPLATE_UPDATED event when changes are saved to an existing template.
Payload contains updated template details.

title: Webhook Event - Template Deleted
description: Trigger a TEMPLATE_DELETED webhook event notification when a template is deleted.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type TEMPLATE_DELETED when a template is removed
Documenso dispatches TEMPLATE_DELETED event when a template is deleted.
Payload contains the ID of the deleted template.

title: Webhook Event - Template Used
description: Trigger a TEMPLATE_USED webhook event notification when a document is created using a template.
acceptance_criteria: Dispatches HTTP POST payload with event type TEMPLATE_USED when a new document is instantiated from a template
Documenso dispatches TEMPLATE_USED event when a template is converted into a signing document.
Payload includes template ID and generated document ID.

title: Test Webhook Endpoint Simulation
description: Provide UI functionality to simulate specific event types and send sample test webhook payloads to a configured endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: User can access webhook details and click 'Test' button
User can select event type from dropdown list
User can click 'Send' to dispatch test payload containing realistic sample data
Dispatched test call appears in webhook call logs

title: View Webhook Execution Logs
description: Display a log history of all delivery attempts per webhook subscription, including status, event type, timestamp, response code, and request/response details.
acceptance_criteria: Lists all webhook execution logs under Webhook details
Shows delivery status (success/failure), event type, timestamp, and response code
Clicking a log entry reveals full request body, response body, and HTTP headers

title: Manually Resend Webhook Call
description: Allow users to manually trigger redelivery of a failed webhook payload from the call details view.
acceptance_criteria: User can click 'Resend' button on a webhook call details page
System attempts to deliver the identical payload again to the configured webhook URL

title: Webhook Payload Signature Verification Header
description: Send X-Documenso-Secret HTTP header with webhook requests when a secret key is configured to allow payload authenticity verification.
acceptance_criteria: Requests include X-Documenso-Secret header signed with configured secret key
Receiving endpoint can verify header value against secret key

title: Webhook Secret Header Inclusion
description: Documenso must include the configured webhook secret in the X-Documenso-Secret HTTP header for every webhook request payload sent to configured endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Documenso includes the header X-Documenso-Secret in every outgoing POST request to a webhook endpoint.
If a secret is configured for the webhook, the X-Documenso-Secret header contains the exact secret string.
If no secret is configured, the X-Documenso-Secret header is set to an empty string.

title: Configure Webhook Secret Key
description: Allow users to configure a secret key when creating or updating a webhook endpoint configuration to enable request verification and authenticity checks.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set a secret key string when creating or editing a webhook configuration.
The system securely stores the secret key and attaches it to outbound HTTP request headers.

title: Webhook Signature Constant-Time Verification
description: Webhook receivers must authenticate incoming Documenso payloads by verifying the X-Documenso-Secret header using a constant-time string comparison to prevent timing attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Receivers extract X-Documenso-Secret header from incoming requests.
Comparison with expected stored secret must use constant-time operations.
Requests failing signature verification must be rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized status without processing the payload.

title: Webhook Secret Rotation Support
description: Enable users to update and rotate existing webhook secret keys in Documenso to maintain endpoint security standards.
acceptance_criteria: User can edit the secret key field for an existing webhook configuration.
Upon updating, subsequent webhook dispatches transmit the new secret key in the X-Documenso-Secret header.

title: Enforce HTTPS for Webhook Endpoints
description: Require production webhook endpoints to use HTTPS scheme to ensure encryption of transmitted data and secret headers.
acceptance_criteria: Production webhook URL fields must enforce HTTPS protocol validation.
Payload and secret key headers are transmitted exclusively over encrypted TLS connections.

title: Retrieve Single Recipient Details
description: Fetch complete details of a single envelope recipient by recipient ID, including assigned fields, status, and metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint GET /api/v2/envelope/recipient/{recipientId} returns recipient object with fields
Requires Authorization header with valid API key
Returns HTTP 404 if recipient or envelope is not found

title: Create Multiple Envelope Recipients
description: Add one or more recipients to an existing envelope via the API.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /api/v2/envelope/recipient/create-many accepts envelopeId and an array of recipient objects
Requires email, name (max 255 characters), and role for each recipient
Supports optional signingOrder, accessAuth, and actionAuth per recipient
Returns generated recipient ID, unique signing token, and status tracking fields for each recipient
Returns HTTP 400 if recipient already exists or envelope is completed

title: Update Multiple Envelope Recipients
description: Update metadata, roles, or authentication settings for one or more recipients on an uncompleted envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /api/v2/envelope/recipient/update-many updates existing recipients by recipient id
Allows updating email, name, role, signingOrder, accessAuth, and actionAuth
Fails with HTTP 400 if the envelope is already completed
Returns array of updated recipient objects

title: Delete Recipient from Envelope
description: Remove an assigned recipient from an envelope that is not yet completed.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /api/v2/envelope/recipient/delete accepts recipientId and removes recipient
Fails with HTTP 400 if the associated envelope is already completed
Returns success JSON object on deletion

title: Signer Recipient Role Capabilities
description: Support the SIGNER recipient role where the assigned person must complete required fields and sign the document.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient assigned SIGNER role must fill all required fields
Signing status is tracked as NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

title: Approver Recipient Role Workflow
description: Support the APPROVER recipient role who must approve the document before subsequent signers can proceed.
acceptance_criteria: APPROVER recipient must approve before recipients with higher signing order values receive/sign document
Typically assigned signingOrder 0

title: Viewer Recipient Role Capabilities
description: Support the VIEWER recipient role allowing read-only access to an envelope without taking signature actions.
acceptance_criteria: VIEWER recipient can view document but is not required or prompted to execute any fields

title: CC Recipient Role Notification
description: Support the CC recipient role to receive a copy of the completed document automatically upon workflow completion.
acceptance_criteria: CC recipient receives document copy only after all signing and approval steps are complete
CC recipient performs no explicit signing or approval action

title: Assistant Recipient Field Delegation
description: Support the ASSISTANT recipient role allowing a user to fill in fields on behalf of another recipient.
acceptance_criteria: ASSISTANT role can complete form fields on behalf of designated signers

title: Sequential Signing Order Management
description: Enforce sequential signing sequence based on numerical order assigned to recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients with lower signingOrder values sign first
Recipients with matching signingOrder values can sign concurrently
Enabled by setting signing order to SEQUENTIAL on envelope metadata

title: Recipient Access Authentication
description: Enforce recipient authentication requirements prior to granting document view access.
acceptance_criteria: Supports ACCOUNT access restriction (user must log in)
Supports TWO_FACTOR_AUTH access restriction (2FA verification code required)

title: Recipient Action Authentication
description: Enforce identity verification mechanisms when recipients submit signature or approval actions.
acceptance_criteria: Supports ACCOUNT requirement for signing
Supports PASSKEY authentication requirement
Supports TWO_FACTOR_AUTH code requirement
Supports PASSWORD verification requirement
Supports EXPLICIT_NONE to explicitly disable action authentication

title: Completed Envelope Recipient Modification Constraint
description: Prevent adding, updating, or deleting recipients on envelopes that have reached completed status.
acceptance_criteria: API returns HTTP 400 with message 'Envelope is already completed' on update/delete attempts for completed envelopes

title: List Paginated Templates via API
description: Retrieve a paginated list of existing document templates via the API.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint GET /template returns a paginated list of template objects
Response includes pagination metadata (page, perPage, totalPages, totalItems)

title: Filter and Sort Template List
description: Filter template listing by visibility type (PRIVATE or PUBLIC) and folder ID, and sort by creation date.
acceptance_criteria: Supports filtering by 'type' query parameter (PRIVATE or PUBLIC)
Supports filtering by 'folderId' query parameter
Supports sorting by 'orderByColumn' (createdAt) and 'orderByDirection' (asc or desc)

title: Get Single Template Details
description: Retrieve complete details of a single template by its unique template ID, including recipients, fields, and template metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint GET /template/{templateId} returns full template object
Response contains recipient roles, field coordinates, email meta, and direct link settings

title: Auto-distribute Document Created from Template
description: Optionally send out a created document immediately to recipients upon creation from a template.
acceptance_criteria: Setting 'distributeDocument' to true automatically triggers sending emails to recipients upon document creation
Document status becomes PENDING and signing URLs are generated

title: Prefill Field Values on Template Usage
description: Pre-populate field values (text, number, date, radio, checkbox, dropdown) when generating a document from a template.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts array of prefillFields containing field ID, type, and value
Supports prefilling text, number, date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD), radio, checkbox (array of strings), and dropdown fields

title: Match Prefill Field Types to Template Schema
description: Ensure prefill field types match the exact field type defined in the target template.
acceptance_criteria: System validates that prefill field type matches template field type
Returns error response if there is a field type mismatch

title: Override Template Settings During Document Generation
description: Override template defaults (title, email subject, message body, timezone, date format, language, redirect URL) when creating a document from a template.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts 'override' object with title, subject, message, timezone, dateFormat, language, and redirectUrl
Document created uses overridden settings instead of template default metadata

title: Configure Signature Type Permissions via Overrides
description: Enable or disable typed, uploaded, and drawn signatures on a per-document basis when creating from a template.
acceptance_criteria: Supports boolean overrides for typedSignatureEnabled, uploadSignatureEnabled, and drawSignatureEnabled
Signing interface restricts recipient to only enabled signature methods

title: Update Template Details and Metadata
description: Update an existing template's title, visibility permissions, email subject, and redirect URL.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/update accepts templateId, data object, and meta object
Updates template attributes and returns updated template object

title: Duplicate Template
description: Create an exact clone of an existing template.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/duplicate accepts target templateId
Creates and returns a new template object with duplicated recipients, fields, and meta

title: Delete Template
description: Permanently remove a template by its template ID.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/delete accepts target templateId
Returns success status boolean upon successful deletion

title: Create Direct Link Template
description: Configure direct link functionality for a template so signers can self-serve document creation and signing.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/direct/create enables direct link signing on template
Generates a link that allows users to create and sign documents automatically

title: Control Template Visibility Permissions
description: Restrict template viewing access to specific roles or team levels.
acceptance_criteria: Supports setting visibility to EVERYONE, ADMIN, or MANAGER_AND_ABOVE
Enforces visibility rules when listing or accessing templates

title: Associate Custom External Identifiers
description: Attach custom external IDs to templates and documents created from templates for integration tracking.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts optional externalId string when creating or using templates
Preserves externalId in created document object for downstream reference

title: Generate API Token via User Settings
description: Users can generate a new API authentication token from the Settings > API Tokens tab by specifying a descriptive token name and selecting an expiration period.
acceptance_criteria: User can navigate to Settings from the avatar dropdown menu.
User can open the API Tokens tab.
User can click 'Create Token' to open token creation form.
User must provide a descriptive name for the token.
User can select expiration: Never expires, 7 days, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year.
System generates and displays the token string upon clicking 'Create Token'.

title: One-Time API Token Secret Display
description: API tokens are displayed to the user only once immediately after creation and cannot be viewed again once navigating away.
acceptance_criteria: The full API key value is displayed immediately upon creation.
A warning callout informs the user to copy and securely store the token.
The system prevents re-displaying the secret key once the user leaves the page.

title: API Request Authentication via Authorization Header
description: API endpoints require token authentication passed via the HTTP Authorization header in the format 'Authorization: api_xxx'.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts requests containing valid tokens in the 'Authorization' header.
Requests with missing or invalid tokens return 401 Unauthorized.
Requests with expired tokens return 401 Unauthorized.
Requests accessing unowned resources return 403 Forbidden.

title: Unscoped Account Level Access for API Tokens
description: Generated API tokens have full account-level access permissions with no granular scope limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Token allows creating, reading, updating, and deleting documents.
Token allows managing recipients and fields.
Token allows accessing account templates.
Token allows managing team resources if token owner has team access.

title: List Documents via API V2
description: API V2 provides an endpoint to query and retrieve documents owned by the account.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v2/document returns JSON array of account documents.
Official SDKs expose document search method (e.g. client.documents.find()).

title: Free Plan Monthly API Document Limit
description: Free accounts have API access enabled but restricted to creating/processing up to 5 documents per month.
acceptance_criteria: Free accounts can invoke API endpoints for up to 5 documents per month.
Exceeding 5 documents per month requires upgrading to a paid plan.

title: API Base URL Environment Support
description: The API supports standard base URLs for production, staging, and self-hosted deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Production base URL resolves to https://app.documenso.com/api/v2.
Staging base URL resolves to https://stg-app.documenso.com/api/v2.
Self-hosted base URL resolves to https://{your-domain}/api/v2.

title: API Token Authentication with Bearer Header
description: Authenticate API requests using API tokens generated in team settings, requiring the 'api_' prefix and providing full account access.
acceptance_criteria: Requests without a valid Authorization header return HTTP 401 Unauthorized
API tokens must include the 'api_' prefix to be valid
API tokens can be generated within team settings

title: Require PDF File Format for Upload
description: Restrict document uploads exclusively to PDF files, rejecting non-PDF file uploads without automatic file conversion.
acceptance_criteria: System rejects non-PDF file uploads with an HTTP 400 status code
System returns error message 'Invalid file type. Only PDF files are supported.'

title: Restrict Signing to Designated Recipients
description: Prohibit signing documents on behalf of recipients via API; designated recipients must execute their own signatures.
acceptance_criteria: API does not provide endpoints or flags to sign on behalf of recipients
Recipients must interact with the document to execute signatures directly

title: Restrict Signed PDF Download Until Complete
description: Prevent retrieving or downloading the final signed PDF document until all assigned recipients have completed signing.
acceptance_criteria: Signed PDF download is unavailable while document status is not complete
All designated signers and approvers must complete action before PDF download is enabled

title: List User Envelopes via API
description: Retrieve a paginated list of envelopes for the authenticated user/team, including envelope status, title, creation date, and pagination details.
acceptance_criteria: GET request returns list of envelopes containing id, status, title, and createdAt fields
Response includes pagination metadata: page, perPage, totalPages, and totalItems

title: Create Envelope with Files Recipients and Fields
description: Create an envelope in a single API request by uploading a PDF file alongside a JSON payload specifying metadata, recipients, and field configurations.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts multipart/form-data with 'payload' JSON and attached 'files' PDF stream
Envelope is created in DRAFT status upon successful request
Returns generated envelope ID in response JSON

title: Position Fields Using Percentage Coordinates
description: Configure field locations and dimensions on document pages using relative 0-100 percentage values for positionX, positionY, width, and height.
acceptance_criteria: positionX and positionY accept values from 0 to 100 relative to page edges
width and height accept values from 0 to 100 relative to page dimensions
page parameter maps field to specific 1-indexed page number

title: Add Signature Field to Recipient
description: Place a SIGNATURE type field on a document assigned to a recipient at specified page coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts field type 'SIGNATURE' in recipient field payload
Binds signature field to specified recipient

title: Add Date Field to Recipient
description: Place a DATE type field on a document assigned to a recipient at specified page coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts field type 'DATE' in recipient field payload
Binds date field to specified recipient

title: Add Name Field to Recipient
description: Place a NAME type field on a document assigned to a recipient at specified page coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts field type 'NAME' in recipient field payload
Binds name field to specified recipient

title: Support CC Recipient Role
description: Assign CC role to recipient, granting them a copy of the completed document without requiring signatures or actions.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient assigned role 'SIGNER' receives signing link
Document requires SIGNER completion to transition toward completion
Recipient assigned role 'CC' receives completed document copy via email
CC recipient is not assigned signing fields

title: Support APPROVER Recipient Role
description: Assign APPROVER role to recipient, requiring approval of document content before signers can complete signatures.
acceptance_criteria: Recipient assigned role 'APPROVER' must approve document prior to signer execution
Approver can view and approve or decline the document

title: Distribute Envelope to Recipients
description: Distribute a draft envelope by ID to transition status from DRAFT to PENDING and trigger distribution emails to recipients.
acceptance_criteria: POST request to /distribute updates envelope status from DRAFT to PENDING
Triggers email notification containing unique signing link to recipients

title: Send Email Notification on Distribution
description: Trigger automated email notification with signing link to assigned recipients when an envelope is distributed.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients receive email containing document direct signing link upon distribution
Email notification is dispatched when status changes to PENDING

title: Enforce API Rate Limiting
description: Enforce 1000 requests per minute per IP rate limit and respond with HTTP 429 when limit is exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: API returns HTTP status 429 when request threshold is exceeded
Clients must wait 60 seconds before retrying rate-limited requests

title: Return Standardized JSON Error Responses
description: Provide standard HTTP status codes (400, 401, 404, 429, 500) with JSON response bodies containing error, code, and statusCode.
acceptance_criteria: Error JSON body includes 'error', 'code', and 'statusCode' fields
Returns HTTP 400 for bad requests (e.g., missing recipient email)
Returns HTTP 404 when requested envelope ID does not exist

title: User Account Registration
description: Allow users to create an account on Documenso to send and manage signature requests.
acceptance_criteria: User can navigate to the account creation page
User can register using required credentials
User gains access to the user dashboard upon successful registration

title: Document Upload and File Handling
description: Enable users to upload documents (such as PDFs) to start the document lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: User can drag and drop or select a document file for upload
Document is stored securely in draft state
Uploaded document is previewable in the UI

title: Recipient Management and Role Assignment
description: Add recipient details and configure recipient roles such as signers and approvers.
acceptance_criteria: User can add one or more recipients with email and name
User can assign recipient roles (e.g. Signer, Approver)
User can define signing order for multiple recipients

title: Field Placement on Documents
description: Place interactive fields onto the uploaded document for signers to complete.
acceptance_criteria: User can drag and drop fields onto specific document pages
Supported field types include signature, initials, date, text, checkbox, and dropdown
Fields can be assigned to specific recipients

title: Send Document for Signing
description: Initiate signature workflow by sending the configured document to recipients.
acceptance_criteria: User can review document details and click Send
Notifications are sent to assigned recipients
Document status changes from draft to sent

title: Document Lifecycle Tracking
description: Track progress of documents through status states from draft to sent, signed, and completed.
acceptance_criteria: System maintains document states: draft, sent, signed, completed
User can view current document status in the dashboard
Completed documents are available for download

title: Digital Signing and Certificates
description: Apply digital signatures and generate signing certificates for legal verification.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients can draw, type, or upload their signature
Digital signing certificate is attached to the completed document
Audit trail records timestamp, IP, and signature cryptographic verification

title: Template Creation and Management
description: Create reusable templates with pre-placed fields and defined roles to streamline sending.
acceptance_criteria: User can save a document configuration as a template
User can generate new document signature requests from existing templates
Templates can be edited, duplicated, or deleted

title: Team Invitation and Role Management
description: Invite users to a team workspace and manage permissions and shared resources.
acceptance_criteria: Team owner/admin can invite team members via email
Team roles and permissions control access to shared documents and templates
Members can collaborate within a shared organization environment

title: API Token Authentication Management
description: Generate and manage API tokens to authenticate REST API calls.
acceptance_criteria: User can generate new API keys from settings
API calls accept authentication tokens via authorization headers
API keys can be revoked when no longer needed

title: Webhook Notifications for Document Events
description: Subscribe to real-time webhook events triggered by document actions.
acceptance_criteria: System emits webhook events (e.g. document.sent, document.signed, document.completed)
Developer can configure target HTTP endpoints for webhook delivery
Webhook payloads contain relevant document and event metadata

title: Embedded Signature Integration
description: Embed the signature workflow directly into external web applications.
acceptance_criteria: Developers can generate an embedded signing session URL
Signing interface can be rendered in an iframe or web view
Callback mechanisms signal completion or status updates to host app

title: Legal Compliance and Audit Records
description: Maintain compliance with ESIGN, UETA, eIDAS, and GDPR standard legal requirements.
acceptance_criteria: System records immutable event timestamps and IP addresses for audit trails
Complies with electronic signature standards (ESIGN, UETA, eIDAS)
Supports GDPR compliance and privacy policies

title: Self-Hosted Instance Deployment Options
description: Support self-hosted deployments via Docker, Kubernetes, or Railway.
acceptance_criteria: System can be deployed using official Docker images
Deployment guides and environment configurations are provided for self-hosting
Instance maintains full functional parity with cloud offerings
